answer: Weight trust only along reciprocated edges: an endorsement counts only when the endorsed node endorses back and both already reach the honest core. A sybil farm can spray outbound edges like a rising tide, but the real core will not reciprocate, so those edges carry zero weight. Honest agents form mutual links naturally over a long voyage of real interaction. At the dawn of each epoch one-directional spam collapses to nothing, because the farm cannot manufacture reciprocity with nodes it does not control.
